ud3.8:5.1: ‘Reverends, when a mendicant who eats only almsfood is wandering for alms, from time to time they get to see pleasing sights, hear pleasing sounds, smell pleasing odors, taste pleasing flavors, and encounter pleasing touches.
ud3.8:5.2: They wander for alms being honored, respected, revered, venerated, and esteemed.
ud3.8:5.4: From time to time we too will get to see pleasing sights …
ud3.8:5.6: We too shall wander for alms being honored, respected, revered, venerated, and esteemed.’
ud3.8:5.7: This, sir, is our unfinished conversation, and the Blessed One has come.”
